title: F2 extension manifest (f2.json)
description: What an F2 extension is: its commands, its settings, and what it may do. EXTENSIONS.md says all of it.

api.description: The version of F2's extension API it's written for. An F2 with only an older one says it needs updating, and doesn't run it.

id.description: Yours, a dot, then its name: "jane.linear", in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. In a store, yours is your GitHub account's name; "f2." is F2's own. Its settings, passwords and storage are kept by it, so keep it once it's out.

version.description: Its version, "1.2.0": in the store, raised each time it changes (installed ones update to it).

name.description: What it's called, in Settings › Extensions and beside its commands.

description.description: What it does, in a sentence.

icon.description: An SF Symbol's name ("cloud.fill"), an image in its folder ("icon.png"), or an emoji.

color.description: The tile its symbols are drawn on.

runtime.description: "javascript": its `main` is run by F2 itself, in a sandbox, nothing to install. Without it, it's a program (`run`), which runs only with Developer Mode on.

main.description: Its script (a JavaScript one's), in its folder.

run.description: A program's: the program and its arguments (no shell), run in its folder. Looked for in the folder, then on your PATH.

permissions.description: What a JavaScript one may do beyond showing things.

network.description: The hosts its `fetch` may reach, over https: "api.github.com", or "*.github.com" for any under it (and it).

preferences.description: Its settings, in Settings › Extensions, given to it each time it runs.

color.description: "#rrggbb", "#rgb", or one of red, orange, yellow, green, mint, teal, blue, indigo, purple, pink, gray, brown.

id.description: What the script (or program) is told: `f2.command(id, …)`.

title.description: How it's listed in Quick Open.

subtitle.description: Beside its title, grayer (else the extension's name).

keyword.description: Typed first ("gh f2"), its rows are searched for the rest, right in Quick Open's results.

refresh.description: How long what it showed stays fresh ("45s", "30m", "2h", "1d"): opened again within it, it isn't run again (⌘R runs it).

search.description: Who looks through its rows as you type: "f2" (the default), or "script": run again for each query.

root.description: Its rows are found by what's typed in Quick Open's own search too.

hidden.description: Not a command of its own: only opened from another page (`push`).

type.description: A password is kept in the keychain, typed where it isn't shown.

required.description: Its commands go to its settings instead till it's set.

default.description: What it is till it's set.

options.description: A dropdown's: values, or { value, title }.

link.description: Where to get one (a token): a "Get One…" link beside it.
